test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which country has sent its former Vice President Ahmed Adeeb to detention center in August 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **former vice president **of the **Maldives **who was **arrested **after **fleeing **to **neighboring India **to **avoid questioning **over the **alleged embezzlement **of state funds has been taken to **a Maldives detention center **after being **returned to the country**.
 
• India had **refused entry **to former **Vice President Ahmed Adeeb**.
 
• **Maldives police **later confirmed that they had **arrested him **and **returned him **to the **Indian Ocean nation**.
 
• **Adeeb **was **brought to Male**, the **Maldives' capital**.
 
• He was taken to the **Dhoonidhoo detention center**.
 
• Adeeb had his **passport confiscated **by a **court order **because of **pending court cases**, **according to police**.
 
• He had **recently been freed **from a **33-year jail **sentence **over corruption and terrorism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** A **place **where people who **have entered a country illegally **are kept for **a period of time**. It is also **called Jail or Prison**.
